map.估算污水处理厂进水污染物负荷。: Estimate the influent pollutant load of a wastewater treatment plant.
map.排放核算：录入流量与 COD 浓度，求日/年污染负荷(kg)。: Discharge accounting: enter the flow and COD concentration to obtain the daily/annual pollutant load (kg).
map.治理规模：按负荷反推处理设施所需去除能力。: Treatment sizing: back-calculate the removal capacity the facility needs from the load.
map.教学演示：演示负荷=流量×浓度的乘法关系。: Teaching demo: show the multiplicative relation load = flow × concentration.
Example: a flow of 1000 m³/d at COD 400 mg/L gives a daily load = 1000×0.4 = 400 kg COD/d.
map.浓度单位怎么用？: How are the concentration units used?
map.mg/L 即 g/m³；负荷(kg/d)=流量(m³/d)×浓度(mg/L)/1: mg/L is the same as g/m³; load (kg/d) = flow (m³/d) × concentration (mg/L) / 1000. Results are estimated according to public standards and environmental factors, for science outreach, teaching and emission-reduction estimates; actual accounting should follow official guidelines (such as the GHG Protocol and provincial carbon emission factors) and measured data.
map.COD 和 BOD 区别？: What is the difference between COD and BOD?
map.COD 测总可氧化有机物、BOD 测可生物降解部分；COD≥BOD，比值反映可生: COD measures all oxidisable organics while BOD measures the biodegradable part; COD ≥ BOD, and the ratio reflects biodegradability. Results are estimated according to public standards and environmental factors, for science outreach, teaching and emission-reduction estimates; actual accounting should follow official guidelines (such as the GHG Protocol and provincial carbon emission factors) and measured data.
map.达标看浓度还是负荷？: For compliance, do we look at concentration or load?
map.排放标准是浓度限值，但治理规模由负荷决定，两者都要看。结果按公开标准与环境因子估: The discharge standard sets concentration limits, but the treatment scale is determined by the load, so both matter.
